description: Mary's Room stage 4.4: persistent surface identity across exposures by cell-set overlap, colour-free. A current SurfaceSegment S (from surface_segmentation, has_boundary=1) continues PersistentSurface P iff ov = #members of S whose prev_sid == P.sid satisfies the track_comps overlap criterion 2*ov >= min(S.n_cells, P.n_cells) (runners/dsl/src/substrate.rs track_comps), P is S's unique overlap argmax, and no other current segment claims P with >= overlap. Otherwise S is born as a new P (sid from SurfaceCounter.next_sid): an ambiguous split/merge is REFUSED rather than guessed, and a P claimed by >= 2 segments with no acceptor is marked 'split'. Unmatched P coast (coast += 1; never deleted). Unlike track_comps the match is order-independent and has no centroid/velocity fallback and no value gate: identity never reads colour. Each cell keeps prev_sid (previous exposure) and cur_sid (this exposure); prev_sid is rolled at the next segmentation reset so overlap always reads the previous epoch. Ganzfeld (has_boundary=0) segments are not offered. Flag SurfacePersistenceParams.enabled, OFF by default (sec 9).

microtheory.name: surface_persistence
microtheory.description: surface segments -> persistent surfaces by cell overlap

rules.name: ps_init
rules.comment: First sight of a cell: no persistent surface yet (sid -1).

rules.name: ps_roll
rules.comment: When segmentation resets a cell for a new epoch, roll its identity clock: prev_sid := cur_sid (the sid assigned at the previous exposure; -1 if that exposure offered no surface, e.g. a ganzfeld), cur_sid := -1. Overlap is computed ONLY from prev_sid, so it always reads the previous epoch.

rules.name: ps_ready
rules.comment: One binding: segmentation has published final_epoch e and every cell has rolled to e -> ready_epoch := e.

rules.name: ps_decide_continue
rules.comment: DECISION ONLY (no P mutation, so every segment's decision is made against the same previous-epoch state): S accepts P (track_comps overlap 2*ov >= min(count), unique argmax, no rival claimant with >= overlap).

rules.name: ps_decide_birth
rules.comment: DECISION ONLY: S accepts no existing P -> birth. birth_reason records whether S claimed some P (overlap passed but the match was ambiguous -> REFUSED) or claimed none.

rules.name: ps_apply_continue
rules.comment: After ALL offered segments of the epoch are decided: link S -segment_of-> P and update P (n_cells, last_epoch, coast 0, status tracked).

rules.name: ps_apply_birth
rules.comment: After ALL offered segments are decided: mint a PersistentSurface with sid = SurfaceCounter.next_sid, then increment the counter (effects apply in order per binding, so concurrent births get distinct sids).

rules.name: ps_mark_cells
rules.comment: Each member cell records its surface for THIS epoch in cur_sid (prev_sid untouched until the next roll).

rules.name: ps_coast
rules.comment: After ALL offered segments are decided, a P not accepted at the ready epoch COASTS (coast += 1; kept, never deleted). status = 'split' if >= 2 current segments claimed it (ambiguous split, refused), else 'coasting'; claims = the claimant count.
